inputs.name: parent
inputs.label: parent of each node (-1 for the root, node 0)

bind.tree: forest([p if p >= 0 else v for v, p in enumerate(parent)])
bind.current: node if __line__ in (10, 14, 15) else v if 'v' in locals() and __line__ == 8 else None
bind.visited: [frm] if __line__ == 14 else [mid] if __line__ == 8 and mid != -1 else []

options.name: up[j][v]: the node 2^j steps above v

bind.values: [r + [None] * (len(parent) - len(r)) for r in up] + ([row + [None] * (len(parent) - len(row))] if 'row' in locals() and (not up or row is not up[-1]) else [])
bind.rows: ['jump ' + str(2 ** j) for j in range(len(up) + (1 if 'row' in locals() and row is not up[-1] else 0))]
bind.cell: [j, v] if __line__ == 8 else [j, frm] if __line__ == 14 else None
